objective: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.

description: Though exiled as a heretic, my beliefs still ring true--that alone drives me onward. But for my destiny to be complete, I need the aid of an outsider... one not of any centaur tribe.
The task requires someone to enter the holy halls of Maraudon--a tomb my people protect, and only the most devout are ever allowed to enter.
If you agree to aid me, then you need only nod. I will pass you a parchment with my instructions on it. Read it over and consider my words.
progress: What did you decide, <name>? Can you help me? Will you set foot on holy ground to help me forge one great centaur tribe!?
completion: This is it, <race>! This is it! Now I can begin the great task of uniting the tribes. Thank you.
Take this for your efforts, please. I hope when next we meet, it will be on much different terms.
